text:
tina: quick idea — can we try moving the weekly triage to FRIDAY 11am for a 6-week trial? want to add a short 10m 'PR pulse' at the start and once-a-month 20m deep-dive on persistent bug patterns. thoughts?

alex: friday would help product folks who are overloaded midweek. +1 to PR pulse — helps us catch review bottlenecks early.

sam: curious about weekend hotfix coverage. if we move, can we keep the hotfix lane owner rotation the same? maybe add a tiny 'handoff' line in the agenda.

tina: yes — keep hotfix rotation. suggested agenda (very compact):
```
1) PR pulse (10m) — short list of PRs blocking releases
2) Hotfix lane & owner handoff (5m)
3) Backlog triage (15m) — prioritize top 6 bugs
4) Monthly deep-dive (20m) — first Fri of the month, optional
```

maria: that agenda looks good. can we also add a 1-slide note on flaky tests in deep-dive month? i've tracked a few recent flakes.

alex: +1 to the slide. also recommend we rotate the PR pulse owner weekly so the same person doesn't do the pull list every time.

sam: suggest a simple cadence: week N owner = same as oncall for that week, unless they're busy. smaller cognitive load.

ops-bot: Reminder: calendar update pending. If triage time moved, update @eng calendar and update invitee list.

alex: who will update the calendar? i can do it today if we agree.

maria: i can draft the PR pulse template — one-line status per PR + blocker tag. will post to the triage doc.

sam: one more ask — can we include a 30s 'blocked by infra' callout in PR pulse for any infra hold-ups? makes escalation faster.

tina: good point. add "infra blockers" bullet in pulse. ok, consensus seems positive. action items:
- alex: update calendar & invite to Fri 11am (trial: 6 weeks)
- maria: PR pulse template and slide skeleton for deep-dive
- sam: confirm hotfix rotation stays same and add handoff line to agenda
- tina: publish trial update in #eng and add a reminder 2 weeks before trial end

alex: done — calendar invite created (Fri 11am, weekly, 6-week trial). added a note about oncall owners for PR pulse. :calendar: ics attached.

maria: PR pulse template posted in the triage doc (link: https://redwood.workspace/triage/pr-pulse). slide skeleton in same doc.

sam: updated the rotation doc and added a 1-line handoff checklist.

ops-bot: Event created: Weekly Engineering Triage — Fri 11:00 AM. Attendees: eng. Next occurrence: 1793024056.

tina: amazing, thanks everyone. i'll post a short follow-up in #eng with the trial details and expected metrics (avg time to triage, PR churn). :rocket:

alex: ping me if anyone can't make a Friday — i'll keep notes and share.

maria: small note — for the deep-dive months, let's invite a PM and QA for 20m. saves follow-ups.

sam: agreed. also can we try the PR pulse as a Slack thread before the meeting for the first 2 weeks? then we can decide if it actually needs meeting time.

tina: good experiment. first 2 weeks: PR pulse async thread, then decide. trial still starts this Friday 11am.

alex: noted. creating a dedicated Slack thread template channel thread for PR pulse.

maria: :thumbsup:

sam: :+1:

ops-bot: Reminder: Please ensure calendar and triage doc permissions are updated for external contractors if applicable.

tina: copy. i'll check permissions. thanks all.
